I picked up the roll and called May over. “Can you hold the bottom still?” I asked. She pressed the paper against the foot of the pantry door while I unrolled it beside the coloured lines. I copied each mark, name and date onto the brown strip. When I reached her shaky red line, May took the pencil. “That one's mine,” she said, making it just as wobbly as before. Dad came back to find us rolling up our new parcel.

That evening, Dad found us in the kitchen of our new flat. May was holding the bottom of the strip against the wall, but my piece of tape kept sticking to my fingers. Dad smoothed it into place. May stood beside the red line and looked up at him. “Can we have one for today?” Dad reached for his pencil and, above her curls, added a short line. Beside the date he wrote, “Our first evening here.”

题面“I left it ___ on the results chart.”欲表达不列入表格时需“left it off the results chart”，填 A off 实为off on；C open 可表示将表上位置空着，D marked亦能表示保留标识。it承接场地上的space，文中没有明确表上为之留格或作标。无法同时满足叙事与自然搭配，不能稳定唯一给分。
